title: [MouseWithoutBorders] Fix InputInjector startup probe and fall back to SendInput on COMException

proposed_comments.body:
**Severity:** `medium`

The Mouse Without Borders App build fails StyleCop `SA1518` because both `InputSimulation.cs` and `InitAndCleanup.cs` have an extra blank line after the final closing brace. Please remove only the surplus final blank line in each file, leaving the normal single newline after the brace; the resulting App build then passes without changing runtime code.

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream App build reports SA1518 in both changed files; removing only each surplus EOF CRLF line was applied literally and the focused App build exited 0.

actions.label: Post inline build-fix comment
actions.note: One prose inline comment covering two surplus EOF blank lines; no apply-ready patch because both raw files have mixed line endings. The eight-request limit is exhausted without automated convergence; this is not approval readiness.
